content.value: You are given a N × N matrix M containing integer values. Replace each element (15) [CO2] M[][j] with the sum of its adjacent elements (top, bottom, left, right). If an adjacent element does not exist (i.e., at edge/corners), consider it as 0. Write the program in C using only pointers and instead of array indexing use pointer arithmetic.
